name: Tekton LA (DTLA Showroom)
old_description: As many other reviews here say, Tekton does a fabulous job printing and offers a wide variety of options to print on.
about:
Tekton LA operates a showroom and production facility in downtown Los Angeles, California, founded in 2019. The company does not disclose its founders or ownership structure in public materials.

The shop provides a full suite of custom merchandise decoration services, including direct-to-garment (DTG) printing up to 24×24 inches, direct-to-film (DTF) printing up to 23×200 inches, screen printing up to 36×48 inches with specialty inks such as puff, high-density, and flock, embroidery up to 30×30 inches with 3D, laser patches, tackle twill, and appliqué, tackle twill application, fabric printing on 100% cotton (non-sublimation), proprietary garment dyeing (potassium, sunfade, reactive), embossing, custom banner production, live on-site printing events throughout California, and content creation including photography and videography. They also stock and sell blank apparel from brands such as Los Angeles Apparel, AS Colour, and Cotton Collective. Facility size, headcount, and annual volume are not disclosed.

Tekton serves the entertainment and technology sectors, along with any brand, event organizer, or business needing custom apparel, headwear, banners, or promotional goods. Customers range from apparel startups seeking private-label fulfillment to production companies requiring live printing activations.

The company emphasizes zero minimum order quantities across all decoration methods, same-day and next-day turnaround options, locally sourced blanks, and a proprietary garment-dye process marketed as Tekton Garment Dye™. It also offers white-label shipping in customer packaging and on-demand live printing experiences.
